**Build from scratch: load up on defence and hand the armband to Bruno.**

**✅ What's strong**
This 5-4-1 build packs £97.5m of value with a projected XI haul of 61.39 pts. Bruno Fernandes (12.0, 6.08 xP) is the standout skipper — nailed, on pens and free-kicks, 0.68 xGI/90. Behind him, Virgil (6.5, 5.52) offers clean-sheet odds and a soft run, while Senesi (6.0) and Tarkowski (6.0) bring elite DEFCON volume for +2 most weeks. Haaland (15.5, 5.29) leads the line. No fitness flags to worry about this week.

**🔄 What I'd change**
Building fresh, so nail the priorities: Bruno as captain, Virgil as your premium defender, and stack cheap DEFCON merchants Senesi and Tarkowski. For value in midfield, Enzo (7.0, 5.36) is the differential to target — nailed, pens #2, real threat. O'Shea (4.0, 4.21) is a superb budget enabler at the back to fund Haaland up top.

**Bottom line: Bruno's armband, a heavy-duty defence and Enzo as your smart differential — this is a squad built to bank points from minute one.**
